text:
emma: Quick sync — we need to lock the post-launch cadence for the next 6 weeks. Major asks: (1) triage backlog vs quick bug squashes, (2) rotating owners for on-call rollout, (3) explicit acceptance criteria for enhancements.

jordan: +1. Can we do a 2-week cadence with an in-between stabilization week? Means deliverables every 14 days and a 7-day buffer for hotfixes/QA.

lee: Sounds sane. For infra-sensitive bugs (p99 regressions) we should have an immediate hotpatch lane that bypasses the regular sprint — limited scope.

marta: From CS: two customers (big accounts) flagged streaming lag and an embeddings mismatch. They expect ETA within 2 weeks for a clear mitigation. Those are our priority signals.

chris: For the embeddings mismatch — I can put up a dark-launch patch that forces the previous model variant for affected customers. Low-risk stopgap. Need owner for the rollback plan.

emma: OK assign owners here: chris -> embeddings rollback plan, jordan -> sprint cadence & prioritization, lee -> hotpatch runbook (p99 escalation). Marta will triage customer comms + escalation.

marta: I'll own comms and create a customer-facing timeline. Will need eng confirmation on rollback impact by EOD tomorrow.

jordan: On backlog prioritization: propose a simple rubric — Severity (S1-S4), Customer impact (Tier A/B/C), Dev effort (T-shirt). We gate enhancements into sprint only if they meet S2+ and Tier A or low effort.

emma: Agree. Add a quality gate: every enhancement must have a clear acceptance test, perf budget (p50/p95), and a rollback trigger.

chris: Can we put the rubric into a tiny doc? I'll draft and post in #docs. Also adding a small eval harness for the top 5 prompts to detect regressions pre-rollout.

lee: Hotpatch runbook notes: 1) triage channel = #prod-hotpatch, 2) deploy window = immediate, 3) rollback policy = auto if p99 > baseline+2x for >5m, 4) postmortem within 48h. I'll push draft to the thread in 1h.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed for release/2026-03-18-embed-fix (ok=84%, fail=0%) :rocket:

emma: Nice. Keep canary metrics front-and-center in the console dashboard (p95, error-rate, tokens/sec). If canary shows regression we abort and inform customers.

marta: Question: do we want a dedicated 'customer hot lane' in the sprint board for Tier A fixes? Means we cut a slot each sprint reserved for customer escalations.

jordan: I support a 1-slot reservation. If unused, it becomes backlog grooming capacity. That keeps us responsive without wrecking planned work.

chris: About owner rotations — propose a 2-week rotation for owners (same as cadence) with a single owner-of-the-week who can reassign. Documentation: oncall-owner rotation in Confluence + a calendar invite.

emma: Let's formalize: two-week sprint, week 1 delivery + week 2 stabilization buffer. One reserved customer-hot-slot per sprint. Roll owner rotates every sprint. Acceptance criteria required for enhancements. Hotpatch lane active for S1/S1.5 infra regressions.

lee: I'll update the oncall runbook and add the auto-triage script to label severity based on metrics.

marta: I'll draft the customer timeline and send to the two accounts — mention fallback (dark launch to previous model).

jordan: For backlog grooming this week: pull top 12 items, tag with rubric, and assign proposals for dev estimates. 1h grooming on Thursday.

emma: Thursday 10:30 PT works. Agenda: 1) Tagging with rubric, 2) Slotting the customer-hot items, 3) Confirm owners.

chris: tiny nit: need a perf budget for the embeddings rollback too (latency + cost). I'll add that to my rollback PR.

emma: Great. Action items: chris -> rollback plan PR (EOD tomorrow), lee -> hotpatch runbook (in 1h), jordan -> grooming agenda + rubric doc (before Thu), marta -> customer timelines (tomorrow noon).

marta: noted. I'll post an update in #customers once I have eng confirmation.

jordan: I'll post the rubric doc to #product and add it to the sprint template.

emma: Thanks all. If we hit any blocker ping here and tag @emma. We'll reconvene after the grooming session to finalize the sprint. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder-bot: Standup rotation changed — new owner for this sprint: jordan.

chris: :thumbsup: moving on the rollback now, will ping when draft is ready.

lee: runbook posted: https://confluence.redwood/Runbooks/Hotpatch-runbook (draft) — feedback welcome.

emma: Closing thread — will create a follow-up summary doc after grooming.
